src/audio1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm Jim Ratcliffe, co-owner of Manchester United and a Glazer ball licker. Britain is going backwards. It is. And somebody has to say it. We've got too many people on benefits, too much immigration, too much government spending. You simply cannot run a country like that.

src/audio2.mp3.text: I can see it very clearly from here in Monaco. Britain needs to learn to live within its means. Ordinary people need to tighten their belts, work harder, expect less. Obviously, I moved to Monaco. But that's different. That was a sensible financial decision.

src/audio3.mp3.text: What Britain needs is sacrifice, difficult decisions, cuts, efficiency, preferably sacrifices made by somebody else. People say Britain used to build things, absolutely. Factories, ships, industry. Now we seem to build paperwork and benefit claims.

src/audio4.mp3.text: And people ask me, Jim, what's the solution? Simple, work harder, spend less, stop complaining. Anyway, I'd say more, but the yacht's waiting.
